newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's January trade deficit $652 million.
newsitem.headline: Israel's January trade deficit $652 million.

text.p: Israel's trade deficit in January totalled $652 million, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Tuesday.
Note - Figures are in millions of dollars.

The bureau said the January figure reflected the continued decline in the trade deficit that began in second-quarter 1996. It said imports (excluding diamonds and fuel) had fallen at a rate of 0.8 to 1.3 percent a month while exports had risen 0.7 to 1.0 percent.

It added that the January trade figures did not include trade with the Palestinian areas. The bureau did not provide separate figures on Palestinian trade, but noted that last year Israel ran a trade surplus of $100 million a month.
